previewText: Flagg attacks again. Eason stays with him. Durant at the rim... and he gets it to go! What a finish!
style: 开场惊讶、突破紧张、终结兴奋、回看平缓。通过情绪参数、短句和节奏实现，不模仿具体解说员身份。

units.text: That's Cooper Flagg, Dallas's twenty twenty-five number-one pick.
units.caption: 这是独行侠的弗拉格，2025年状元。

units.text: Gafford comes over to screen. Watch Eason. He gets around it and stays with Flagg.
units.caption: 加福德尝试掩护；看伊森，绕过去后仍跟着弗拉格。

units.text: Eason's still there. Sengun steps up, too. Flagg backs out. No clean opening yet.
units.caption: 伊森仍在，申京也上前；弗拉格退回来，还没有轻松出手的空间。

units.text: Seven on the clock. Eason's still in front. Here comes Flagg again.
units.caption: 进攻时间只剩约7秒，伊森仍在身前；弗拉格要再启动。
弗拉格突破！伊森继续跟防！

units.text: And there's Durant. Look at that raised hand, and where Flagg holds the ball.
units.caption: 篮下还有杜兰特；看举起的手，和弗拉格持球的位置。
进了！在跟防和协防之间完成终结！

units.text: For this shot, the expected field goal percentage was fifty-one percent.
units.caption: 本次出手的模型预期命中率为51%；不是替换球员后的预测。
